title: Partnerships Lead - AI Startup
description: About Logicc Bei Logicc bauen wir die KI-Plattform für Unternehmen, in denen Vertrauen, Datenschutz und Kontrolle den Arbeitsalltag prägen: von Kanzleien und Healthcare über den Public Sector bis Finance. Wir bringen führende KI-Modelle sicher in den Arbeitsalltag, damit Teams schneller arbeiten und sensible Informationen geschützt bleiben. Die Marktnachfrage ist immens und das Produkt ist zukunftsentscheidend. Was in regulierten Branchen den Unterschied macht, ist die sichere Infrastruktur und das Vertrauen in die Menschen hinter dem Produkt. Für Letzteres suchen wir dich. Aufgaben Als Partnerships Lead baust du strategische Partnerschaften auf, aktivierst unser Partnernetzwerk und entwickelst daraus messbare Pipeline für Logicc. Du verbindest Partner, Sales und Product und sorgst dafür, dass Logicc erfolgreich im Markt eingesetzt wird. Unsere Partner stehen regelmäßig im Austausch mit ihren Kunden und sind deshalb ein wichtiger Hebel für unsere Entwicklung. Du befähigst sie, Logicc sicher zu verstehen, überzeugend zu präsentieren und erfolgreich bei Kunden einzuführen. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich unter anderem in aktivierten Partnern, qualifizierten Opportunities, aufgebauter Partner-Pipeline und erfolgreichen gemeinsamen Kundenprojekten. Partnergewinnung: Du identifizierst relevante Partner, sprichst sie an und führst erste Gespräche über gemeinsame Potenziale. Onboarding & Enablement: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams Use Cases, Demos, Trainings, Sales-Unterlagen und Einwandbehandlungen, mit denen Partner Logicc erfolgreich positionieren können. Partneraktivierung: Du führst Partner von der Registrierung zur ersten qualifizierten Opportunity und baust mit ihnen eine regelmäßige Pipeline auf. Außerdem entwickelst du mit dem Team zusammen Schulungskonzepte, die unsere Partner anwenden können. Partnermanagement: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Partnerportfolio, priorisierst deine Aktivitäten selbst und entscheidest, welche Partnerschaften den größten strategischen und kommerziellen Wert für Logicc haben. Co-Selling & Übergaben: Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Partnern und unserem Sales-Team von der ersten Opportunity bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Partnerschaftspflege: Du hältst Partner über Produktentwicklungen und unsere Roadmap auf dem Laufenden, beantwortest Fragen und bist die erste Ansprechperson für strategische Themen. Voice of the Partner: Du sammelst Erkenntnisse aus Partner- und Kundengesprächen und bringst sie in Product, Marketing, Sales und Customer Success ein. Entwicklungspotential: Du bringst deine eigene Erfahrung und Kreativität mit ein und bringst unserer Partnerships und dich selbst damit aufs nächste Level und noch weiter. Qualifikation Wen wir suchen Du hast bereits 2- 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau von Partnerschaften und deren weiterentwicklung und kannst zeigen, wie du bereits erfolgreich Partner aktiviert, gemeinsame Opportunities entwickelt und neue Prozesse etabliert hast. Du kommunizierst klar, sicher und verbindlich, auf Deutsch mit unseren Partnern und auf Englisch im Team. Du fühlst dich im AI-Umfeld wohl, interessierst dich für neue AI-Tools und hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis dafür, wie sie im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden können. Du kannst dich schnell in Produkte, neue Themen und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen hineindenken. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn sich Prioritäten verändern. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und kannst dich in die Perspektive von Partnern und deren Kunden hineinversetzen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und baust Strukturen auf, wo sie noch fehlen. Dabei verbindest du strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzung. Benefits Kompetetive Vergütung Apple-Setup und moderner SaaS-Stack EGYM Wellpass Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Mittagessen, Snacks, Proteinpulver und Kaffee im Office Das Umfeld Unser zentrales HQ liegt in Hamburg. Dich erwartet ein junges, ambitioniertes Team mit kurzem Draht zu den Gründern. Wir treffen Entscheidungen in Tagen statt in Quartalen und geben dir früh Verantwortung. title: Finanzbuchhalter/in (m/w/d)
description: Seit 2017 verändert HiSERV den GSE-Markt durch hervorragende Qualität, hohe Flexibilität sowie faire und transparente Preise. Wir steuern und bieten unseren Kunden eine junge und moderne Flotte, die den vielfältigen Anforderungen der Luftfahrtbranche gerecht wird. Mit Kurzzeitmiete, Pay-per-Use und Echtzeit-Tracking erfüllen wir die Anforderungen unserer Kunden optimal. Zu unseren Kunden zählen renommierte Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Ground Handling, Airlines und Flughäfen in Europa. Durch den Einsatz innovativer digitaler Lösungen liefern wir zuverlässige Daten zur Optimierung von Nutzung und Kosten. Darüber hinaus bieten wir ein breites Portfolio ergänzender Dienstleistungen rund um die GSE-Vermietung, darunter Beratung, Wartung, Flottenmanagement, Schulungen und weitere Serviceleistungen. Wir suchen am Standort Schönefeld bei Berlin zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Finanzbuchhalter/in (m/w/d) Deine Aufgaben: Bearbeitung und Überwachung der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung. Prüfung, Verbuchung und Nachverfolgung von Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen. Überwachung und Erfassung von Kosten im Zusammenhang mit Wartung, Reparaturen, Ersatzteilen und Arbeitsleistungen. Sicherstellung einer termingerechten Rechnungsbearbeitung und Zahlungsabwicklung. Unterstützung bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen. Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien sowie gesetzlicher und steuerlicher Vorgaben. Mitwirkung bei internen und externen Audits. How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.

You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.

What you'll do

  • Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

  • Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

  • Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

  • Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

  • Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

  • Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

  • Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

  • Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with recent experience owning enterprise or B2B product

  • A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers

  • Experience shipping enterprise capabilities such as admin, permissions, billing, or security, and driving adoption across large customer accounts

  • Deep familiarity with how creative, marketing, and media teams work, and a habit of bringing customer insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Experience working directly with sales and customers and turning a high volume of requests into a clear, prioritized roadmap

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for product quality and the ability to mock up concepts and workflows yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs

  • Strong product judgment and a clear point of view on what to build and why

  • A bias toward shipping and iterating over long alignment cycles

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig. title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Mission
Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen

  • Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte

  • Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander

  • Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können

  • Du automatisierst die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Landingpages und sorgst dafür, dass aus wenigen Inputs möglichst schnell hochwertige, conversionstarke Seiten entstehen

  • Du entwickelst und automatisierst AI-Video-Workflows – von der ersten Idee über unterschiedliche Hooks und Szenen bis hin zu Varianten, Formaten und Cutdowns

Creative-Produktion & Performance

  • Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate

  • Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst, erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen

  • Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

  • Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann

  • Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen

  • Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten


Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit.

  • Du bist AI-Native. Claude, Prompting, Make und generative AI gehören für dich zum täglichen Werkzeugkasten und sind keine Buzzwords.

  • Tools wie Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney oder vergleichbare Lösungen hast du dir idealerweise selbst beigebracht – und du beschäftigst dich bereits mit den Tools, die sie morgen ersetzen könnten.

  • Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne AI-Tools, sondern kannst erkennen, wie unterschiedliche Tools zu einem sinnvollen Workflow zusammenspielen.

  • Du hast Spaß daran, Prozesse zu automatisieren und stellst dir regelmäßig die Frage: Warum machen wir das eigentlich noch manuell?

  • Du kannst Creatives nicht nur automatisieren, sondern hast selbst ein gutes Verständnis für Design, Content, Paid Social und Conversion.

  • Du verstehst, was einen guten Hook, eine starke Ad und eine funktionierende Landingpage ausmacht.

  • Du kannst Performance-Daten lesen und daraus konkrete Entscheidungen ableiten. Für dich gehören Creative und Performance zusammen.

  • Geschwindigkeit ist für dich kein Widerspruch zu Qualität. Die Vorstellung, sehr große Mengen an Creative-Varianten zu produzieren und zu testen, motiviert dich eher, als dass sie dich abschreckt.

  • Gleichzeitig hast du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch: AI-Output darf nicht billig oder beliebig nach AI aussehen.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und hast Lust darauf, Dinge aufzubauen, für die es noch keine fertige Anleitung gibt.

  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Start-up-Umfeld wohl, übernimmst Verantwortung und möchtest Strukturen nicht nur nutzen, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Make, APIs, Webhooks oder No-/Low-Code-Automatisierungen

  • Grundverständnis für LLMs, APIs und AI Agents

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierter Landingpage-Erstellung

  • Erfahrung in der Immobilienbranche


Was wir dir bieten:

  • Freue dich auf einen modernen Arbeitsplatz direkt in Charlottenburg – inklusive Dachterrasse für die Mittagspause oder den After-Work-Drink. Für Snacks und Getränke ist bei uns immer gesorgt
  • Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
  • Der Zusammenhalt ist uns wichtig – diesen fördern wir durch regelmäßige gemeinsame Lunches, Dinner sowie Teamevents
  • Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Kommunikation über alle Bereiche hinweg
  • Als wachsendes Unternehmen bieten wir dir ein spannendes Umfeld, in dem du dich aktiv einbringen und dich innerhalb deiner Rolle weiterentwickeln kannst
  • Individuelle Benefits: Neben einer fairen Bezahlung entscheidest du selbst, welches Extra dich am besten unterstützt: Ob Mobilitätsbudget, monatliches Shopping-Guthaben oder ein Essenszuschuss. Zusätzlich profitierst du von exklusiven Rabatten über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal

title: Werkstudent:in Operations & Customer Experience
description: nuuEnergy - Das sind WIR! nuuEnergy hat es sich zur Mission gemacht, die Wärmewende anzuführen, die Europa dringend braucht! Du willst nicht Kaffee kochen, sondern sehen, wie ein Climate-Tech-Startup von innen funktioniert? Wir suchen Dich als Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund:innen, den Montageteams in unseren Hubs und dem Team in der Zentrale. Du löst Probleme, planst Einsätze und baust die Prozesse mit auf, mit denen wir in den nächsten Jahren wachsen. Klingt spannend? Dann lies weiter! Über uns Wir sind ein Climate-Tech-Start-up aus München und revolutionieren Wärmepumpeninstallationen: mit smarten End-to-End-Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen, ehrlichem Handwerk, regionalen Teams und Anlagen, die wirklich funktionieren. Was heißt das genau? Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für Wärmepumpen-Standorte in ganz Deutschland. Unsere regionalen Standorte („Hubs“) installieren Wärmepumpen bei Hausbesitzer:innen; Prozesse, Kundenakquise, Recruiting und eigene Software kommen zentral aus unserem HQ in München. Was uns besonders macht? Unsere Kombination aus Start-up-Dynamik, Handwerksstolz und echter Sinnhaftigkeit. Wir haben ein starkes Führungsteam, viele Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und vergeben Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Deine Aufgaben Warum es diese Rolle gibt: Mit jeder Wärmepumpe, die wir installieren, wächst die Zahl unserer Kundinnen und Kunden, die auch nach der Installation gut betreut werden wollen. Rückfragen, Wartungen, kleine Störungen: Wie wir damit umgehen, entscheidet, ob jemand uns weiterempfiehlt. Deshalb bauen wir hier unsere operativen Prozesse weiter aus. Du bist am Kundentelefon die erste Ansprechperson, sorgst dafür, dass Wartungstermine zuverlässig geplant werden, und findest heraus, wo unsere Serviceprozesse noch haken. Die Ausführung vor Ort übernehmen unsere Handwerksteams in den Hubs. Du hältst die Fäden zusammen und machst den Ablauf Schritt für Schritt besser. Was heißt das genau? 
Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für Wärmepumpen-Standorte in ganz Deutschland. Unsere regionalen Standorte („Hubs“) installieren Wärmepumpen bei Hausbesitzer:innen; Prozesse, Kundenakquise, Recruiting und eigene Software kommen zentral aus unserem HQ in München.

description: Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. Exolaunch , headquartered in Berlin, Germany with offices in the U.S., France, and Japan, is a global leader in launch mission integration and deployment technologies for small satellites. With a decade of flight heritage and over 841 satellites launched across 49 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. Exolaunch fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies. Brand presence and consistent messaging are essential enablers of our success. As the Marketing Director (m/w/d) at Exolaunch, you will serve as a core strategic leader driving our global marketing, brand presence, and multi-channel social media accounts, while exercising hands-on ownership of our public image, press relations, and executive communications. We’re looking for a visionary marketing leader and creative storyteller with deep expertise in luxury branding, premium positioning, and high-impact copywriting. The ideal candidate brings an exceptional grasp of brand strategy and global communications, capable of converting complex technical achievements into compelling narratives for industry leaders, partners, and international media. As a senior strategist, you will lead brand governance, steer cross-functional marketing initiatives, and oversee data-driven performance analytics. You will be expected to quantify Return on Investment and Return on Effort across all campaigns to ensure Exolaunch remains top-of-mind in our industry. You will lead a small but powerful and passionate internal communications team and manage external PR agencies and advisors as needed. Strategic Marketing & Brand Leadership: You will define and execute our end-to-end global marketing strategy, ensuring consistency of brand identity across digital platforms and industry events. You will collaborate internally with all departments to translate technical innovation into flagship marketing campaigns while engaging externally with launch partners, customers, investors and other key stakeholders to solidify market awareness and top positioning. Communications & Executive Media Relations: You will lead execution of internal and external-facing communications activities, such as press releases, journalist inquiries, events (internal and external), and internal newsletters. This includes keeping company templates with boilerplate language, numbers, and figures current, fielding interview requests and coordinating conference and other public speaking engagements for staff, enforcing launch provider guidelines for external communications from our customers, and coordinating press releases intended for public release. Please provide a portfolio of your previous work with your application. This is a full-time, 12 month contract, based in Berlin, with renewal option at end of contract. Your mission Execute an integrated communication strategy that aligns with the company's objectives and values. Serve as a company spokesperson and manage media relations, proactively seeking opportunities for media coverage and managing crisis communication as needed. Craft compelling messages that further refines Exolaunch’s brand voice, style, and tone. Oversee and implement the creation and approval of press releases, articles, blog posts, social media content, and other communication materials. Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you.

Exolaunch, headquartered in Berlin, Germany with offices in the U.S., France, and Japan, is a global leader in launch mission integration and deployment technologies for small satellites. With a decade of flight heritage and over 841 satellites launched across 49 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. Exolaunch fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.


Brand presence and consistent messaging are essential enablers of our success.  As the Marketing Director (m/w/d) at Exolaunch, you will serve as a core strategic leader driving our global marketing, brand presence, and multi-channel social media accounts, while exercising hands-on ownership of our public image, press relations, and executive communications.


We’re looking for a visionary marketing leader and creative storyteller with deep expertise in luxury branding, premium positioning, and high-impact copywriting. The ideal candidate brings an exceptional grasp of brand strategy and global communications, capable of converting complex technical achievements into compelling narratives for industry leaders, partners, and international media. As a senior strategist, you will lead brand governance, steer cross-functional marketing initiatives, and oversee data-driven performance analytics. You will be expected to quantify Return on Investment and Return on Effort across all campaigns to ensure Exolaunch remains top-of-mind in our industry. B. title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise. We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs. Why This Role Matters Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions. Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines. Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts. Organizational Structure: The Four Domains You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas: Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements. Core Accountabilities 1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities. AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows. Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity. Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access. 2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls. Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly. Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor. 3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection. Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function. Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter. DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting. Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets. Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors. 4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team. Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines. Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board. 12-Month Success Metrics: Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company. Candidate Profile: Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership. Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert. Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks. AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks. Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks. FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR). Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains. Bonus: Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP). Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures. German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

  • Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

  • Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

  • Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

  1. Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

  2. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

  3. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership.

  4. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements.

Core Accountabilities

1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening

  • Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities.

  • AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows.

  • Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity.

  • Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access.

2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement

  • Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls.

  • Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly.

  • Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry.   • DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting.

  • Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors.

Dein Impact @ Carwow

Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist.

YouTube: Bewegtbildkampagnen im Carwow Umfeld und mit Carwow Zielgruppen, von Awareness bis Klick

Meta: Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram, ausgesteuert auf Menschen, die gerade nachweislich ein Auto suchen

Data: Datenberatung auf Basis der Carwow Daten, verbunden mit unserem Verständnis des deutschen Automarkts

Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein

Your mission

Bookboost is the Hospitality Engagement Platform that empowers hotels to understand and engage their guests like never before. We unify guest data, automate personalised communication, and deliver experiences that drive revenue, loyalty, and operational excellence.

We have customers across more than 20 countries and a platform that wins on depth. We're now looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help us build the next stage of it.

Tech stack: Angular | TypeScript | Node.js | Cloudflare Workers | AWS | PostgreSQL | Terraform


Your profile

As a Full Stack Engineer you build and maintain the systems behind our platform: real-time data processing, the APIs that hold it together, and the experience our customers use every day.

The job is shifting from writing syntax to designing systems. We want engineers who are architects: people who define the right abstractions, shape the right interfaces, and make decisions that hold up six months later. Agents write a growing share of the code. Your value is in orchestrating intent, context and execution.

You would be joining a small engineering team with real latitude on technical direction. This is not a seat implementing someone else's design. If you want to be handed tickets and left alone, this is not that job. If you want a say in how the platform is built, it is a good one.

What you'll own and deliver

  • Scalable, high-performance applications across the stack
  • Frontend applications in Angular, with genuine attention to responsiveness and user experience
  • APIs designed with the rest of the team, focused on event-driven architecture and real-time data
  • Edge computing work using Cloudflare Workers, improving performance and deployment efficiency
  • Migration of services to edge runtimes, improving scalability and reducing latency
  • Architectural decisions that outlive the tickets that prompted them
  • Cross-functional work with design, product and Operations on what customers actually need
What makes you a great fit?
  • Full stack depth: 4+ years with modern frontend and backend technologies, and production systems you have owned rather than contributed to
  • Backend: strong in Node.js or another JavaScript runtime, and TypeScript. PHP and Laravel are a plus, not a requirement.
  • Data: relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimisation
  • Frontend: modern frameworks, particularly Angular
  • Edge: familiarity with Cloudflare Workers and services such as Durable Objects, KV and Workflows, or other edge runtimes
  • Cloud: understanding of cloud architecture, particularly AWS
  • AI fluency: our engineering team runs on an AI-native stack. You write code and documentation with AI tools and can talk concretely about how that has changed the way you work. This is a genuine requirement, not a bonus line.
  • Systems thinking: root cause over band-aids, patterns over one-offs. You would rather fix the shape of a problem than patch it again.
  • Craft: you care about reliability, observability, testability and documentation
  • Language: fluent English. Swedish is not required.
What's in it for you?
  • Remote and flexible working, from home or one of our hubs
  • Real influence over technical direction at a company still deciding
  • An engineering team building new ways of working with AI rather than bolting it on
  • An environment that values your judgement, with real room for impact
  • Regular team events and socials

Bookboost gives hotel groups ownership of their guest relationships. We unify guest data across the PMS, booking engine and every communication channel, then orchestrate the guest journey pre-stay, in-stay and post-stay. raw.title: Head of Engineering (Berlin, hybrid)
raw.description:
A little about us

  • What we're building: Kittl is becoming the AI-native, operating system for creative businesses. Most businesses don't lose on product, they lose on how they show up. We give small brands the creative firepower to look credible and get from idea to launch-ready, with no agency and no design team
  • Rapid growth: 11 million users since 2022
  • Diverse team: 120+ people from 30+ countries, with offices in Berlin and Düsseldorf and teammates working remotely
  • Truly product-led company: Engineers, Product Managers and Designers sit at the core of what we build
  • Backing: Raised ~$50M, led by IVP with Left Lane Capital and Speedinvest. IVP has also backed Figma, Slack, and Dropbox

Learn more: www.kittl.com/career

Your role at Kittl

Kittl's engineering team builds the product 11 million users rely on. As our Head of Engineering, you'll build the organisation behind it: you'll manage engineers directly and turn capable team leads into strong managers. You'll own how we deliver, which means finding what really slows us down, fixing the system and proving it worked, with the team we already have. Reporting to our CTO, Phil, you'll shape engineering strategy with him and work hand in hand with Product and Marketing so our capacity goes where Kittl is heading. If you want the organisation you leave behind to be your best work, this is the role.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Grow your leads: Coach first-time team leads into confident managers, and manage your engineers directly with clear expectations and honest feedback
  • Build the people basics: Set fair, consistent standards for performance, feedback, career growth and onboarding, much of it from scratch
  • Unblock delivery: Find the real bottleneck, change the system and show that it worked, so delivery gets more predictable with the team we already have
  • Own quality: Earn senior engineers' trust quickly and take real ownership of quality, so release decisions no longer depend on the CTO
  • Connect up and across: Shape engineering strategy with the CTO, keep leadership updated on progress and risks, and turn strategy into what your teams actually work on
  • Stay technically close: Weigh in on architecture and technical direction, and stay close enough to the code to make good calls

Requirements

What you'll need

  • Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years managing engineering teams
  • Leaders you've grown: You've turned senior engineers or team leads into managers, and can tell us who, how and what changed
  • Delivery you've fixed: You've measurably improved how a team ships, without adding people to do it
  • Technical credibility: Strong background in software development, architecture and systems design, in a TypeScript, React and Node.js stack. Senior engineers trust your calls
  • People-first leadership: You get energy from growing people, and you've built teams others want to join

Interview process

  • Recruiter interview (45 min)
  • CTO & People interview (70 min)
  • Product & delivery interview (45 min)
  • Meeting the team (2 × 30 min)
  • Bar raiser interview with our Head of Data, plus lunch with the team leads in our Berlin office (45 min + lunch)

Our core tech stack

TypeScript, Python, Node.js, React, Next.js, Postgres, Pulumi, k8s

You'll do well here if:

  • You pick up problems nobody assigned you. If something's broken and no one has stepped up, you're the person who does
  • You'd rather make the call and adjust than wait until you're certain. Speed is how we win
  • You want to own a domain deeply enough that people rely on your judgement in it, whether or not you manage anyone
  • You'll argue for your position and commit fully when the call goes the other way
  • You care about details other people would call excessive. We hold a higher bar than most, on purpose
  • You use AI constantly and still own every word you ship

Every new hire should raise the bar in some meaningful way, not just fill a seat. We hold to that, and it's why you'll be working with the most talented people from all over the world.

Benefits

  • Real ownership: You own what you ship, end to end. Whether you lead a team or lead through craft, we back you to work on what matters most
  • Work at the edge of AI and design: Kittl sits where AI, design and commerce meet. You'll be learning on the frontier, not reading about it
  • Work-life balance: 30 vacation days a year, plus public holidays
  • Hybrid working style: 3 days a week in our office in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, the rest of the week from home
  • Remote work: On top of that, work from anywhere in the world for up to 50 days (10 weeks) a year
  • VESOP: Enrolment in our Virtual Employee Stock Option Plan. When Kittl grows in value, you share in it
  • Lunch: Daily chef-prepared meals in the office
  • Mobility: Your monthly BVG ticket, fully covered
  • Health & fitness: Urban Sports Club M membership
  • Learning & development: Annual L&D budget for your professional growth
  • German classes: Online group courses at every level
  • Hackathons: Quarterly hackathons to experiment with new ideas, push boundaries and build the next big thing
  • Kittl Week: Each year, our global team gathers for a whole week to work, celebrate, get inspired and have fun

raw.description:
A little about us

  • What we're building: Kittl is becoming the AI-native, operating system for creative businesses. Most businesses don't lose on product, they lose on how they show up. We give small brands the creative firepower to look credible and get from idea to launch-ready, with no agency and no design team
  • Rapid growth: 11 million users since 2022
  • Diverse team: 120+ people from 30+ countries, with offices in Berlin and Düsseldorf and teammates working remotely
  • Truly product-led company: Engineers, Product Managers and Designers sit at the core of what we build
  • Backing: Raised ~$50M, led by IVP with Left Lane Capital and Speedinvest. IVP has also backed Figma, Slack, and Dropbox

Learn more: www.kittl.com/career

Your role at Kittl

Kittl's marketing is conversion-led - great at driving performance, but no one owns what Kittl is like, how it makes people feel, or whether our target audience has even heard of us. We need someone who can write the line that makes a founder feel seen, and who's restless about getting Kittl in front of that founder in the first place - through ideas bold enough to actually cut through. This works alongside our design lead, who owns visual identity. This role owns voice, story, and standing out.

Tasks

This role is for you if:

  • You have a gift for language - you notice when a sentence is doing real work versus just filling space
  • You get restless with "safe" - you'd rather pitch the slightly-crazy activation that gets talked about than the tenth version of a banner ad
  • You think about audience obsessively - not just what to say, but where our founders actually are, and how to show up there in a way that sticks
  • You notice the thing everyone else scrolled past - the landing page headline that's almost right, the caption that undersells the idea, the touchpoint nobody double-checked
  • You are both creative and strategic - you can go bananas with ideas, and just as readily hold the line on what keeps them on-brand

What you'll do

  • Define and codify Kittl's voice and tone - then write the work yourself (manifesto, campaign copy, landing pages, launch narratives) at a level others can point to as the standard
  • Dream up and lead brand activations, stunts, and campaigns designed to get Kittl in front of small business founders and make them actually care - concept through delivery
  • Represent brand thinking in leadership and strategy conversations, pushing back where decisions threaten brand consistency/integrity
  • Find and pitch unconventional ways to build awareness - partnerships, community moments, founder-facing events, anything that gets us known beyond our existing paid and influencer channels
  • Bring bold, sometimes "crazy" ad concepts to growth/performance marketing - and know how to make them convert, not just turn heads
  • Guide teams early - in briefs and reviews - so tone and ambition are right from the start, not fixed after
  • Audit our messaging and presence across our touch-points (website, landing pages, ad/video scripts, campaign concepts, brand activations), ensuring excellence and consistency in all

Requirements

Who you are

  • 5+ years (sharp instincts, real experience, not yet coasting on a title)
  • You have done this in-house - ideally agency first, then owning brand at a small company where there was no one else to hand it to.
  • You know how to move from a wild idea to something that actually ships
  • You've picked the channel, not just written the words - activations, partnerships, events, community, wherever your audience actually is
  • You are comfortable being the lone brand voice in a growth-led org
  • Background in FMCG, DTC, or consumer goods brands is a strong plus
  • Social media or community-building experience is a plus

Show us, don't tell us

Send us 3 pieces (in the cover letter section) you owned end to end - a campaign, an activation, a launch, a piece of writing that did real work. For each one, tell us briefly: what you did, where it ran, and what happened. We'd rather see one scrappy idea you fought for and shipped than five polished pages from a deck.

Interview process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)
  • Hiring Manager interview (45 min)
  • Case Study interview (60 min)
  • Bar Raiser interview (45 min)

You'll do well here if:

  • You pick up problems nobody assigned you. If something's broken and no one has stepped up, you're the person who does
  • You'd rather make the call and adjust than wait until you're certain. Speed is how we win
  • You want to own a domain deeply enough that people rely on your judgement in it, whether or not you manage anyone
  • You'll argue for your position and commit fully when the call goes the other way
  • You care about details other people would call excessive. We hold a higher bar than most, on purpose
  • You use AI constantly and still own every word you ship

Every new hire should raise the bar in some meaningful way, not just fill a seat. We hold to that, and it's why you'll be working with the most talented people from all over the world.

Benefits

  • Real ownership: You own what you ship, end to end. Whether you lead a team or lead through craft, we back you to work on what matters most
  • Work at the edge of AI and design: Kittl sits where AI, design and commerce meet. You'll be learning on the frontier, not reading about it
  • Work-life balance: 30 vacation days a year, plus public holidays
  • Hybrid working style: 3 days a week in our office in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, the rest of the week from home
  • Remote work: On top of that, work from anywhere in the world for up to 50 days (10 weeks) a year
  • VESOP: Enrolment in our Virtual Employee Stock Option Plan. When Kittl grows in value, you share in it
  • Lunch: Daily chef-prepared meals in the office
  • Mobility: Your monthly BVG ticket, fully covered
  • Health & fitness: Urban Sports Club M membership
  • Learning & development: Annual L&D budget for your professional growth
  • German classes: Online group courses at every level
  • Hackathons: Quarterly hackathons to experiment with new ideas, push boundaries and build the next big thing
  • Kittl Week: Each year, our global team gathers for a whole week to work, celebrate, get inspired and have fun

REPORTS TO

CEO / Founder. Peer to COO and Head of Design. Member of the leadership team.

TEAM

3-5 full-time engineers.

WHO WE ARE

NIX is working towards a fully automated clothing production line in Europe. We’re starting with the simplest, most challenging product: a cotton jersey T-shirt. By the end of April 2027, our production line is expected to produce 5–10 shirts per day, with fewer than two manual interventions per shirt. A key problem with our production line remains unsolved: holding, stretching, and securing fabric that sags while a machine sews.

If that sounds like the most interesting problem in manufacturing and robotics, it is probably exactly the right one for you.

WHAT YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  1. The production line and the roadmap. The milestones are set against one target: a proof of concept by April 2027, 5–10 shirts per day. The roadmap states milestones, blockers and gates. We want you to challenge every aspect of it — and to build the line against those targets.

  2. Digital Transformation: Drive Industry 4.0 initiatives like IoT, AI-driven predictive maintenance, and automation on the factory floor.

  3. The technical team: hiring, leading, developing. You set the standard and you protect the focus.

  4. Design for automation: negotiating with Product and Design which garment features stay, which ones change, and what a future style must respect to be machine-makeable.

  5. Suppliers and partners: finding them, qualifying them, negotiating. Supplier acquisition is a core skill here.

  6. Finance: technical budget, cost breakdowns, CapEx versus OpEx, and estimates that survive being challenged. You build and defend the technical part of our funding case.

  7. Investors and public funding: technical due diligence, and the technical substance behind the grant applications our advisor is writing.

  8. Machine safety and CE: you own the risk assessments and the conformity of what we build, with external safety engineering support.

  9. IP: what we protect, what we publish, what we deliberately leave open.

  10. Research partnerships with universities and institutes — scoped, time-boxed, with a specific research question under investigation.

WHAT YOU MUST BRING

TEXTILES AND MATERIALS

Knowledge of textile technology, garment manufacturing and material behaviour. Without it, show us that you learn a new material domain extremely fast — and how you did that before. Ideally B.Eng./ M.Eng/M.Sc. in Textile Engineering /Mechanical Engineering /Robotics Engineering

SYSTEMS THINKING

You see the line as one system. You can explain why a decision at the cutting table shows up as a defect at the hem — and you can put a number on it.

HANDS-ON ENGINEERING

Automation, mechanical engineering and robotics, from your own hands. You will be in the workshop, at the machine, with fabric in your hands.

SPEED WITH A STEADY HAND

High cadence, quick decisions, 80 % information is enough to act. And at the same time calm — because a team that is rushed stops iterating and starts hiding problems. Urgency without panic.

BIAS TO ACTION

You would rather build a rough prototype this week than write a specification.

COMFORT WITH UNCERTAINTY

A core problem of our line is unsolved. You must be able to work, decide and lead a team without knowing whether it will work — and to stop a line of work honestly when the evidence says stop.

LEADERSHIP WITH EMPATHY

Proven experience leading engineers. People stay and grow under you. You give direct feedback and help them grow.

MONEY LITERACY

Budgeting, cost models, estimate quality, runway awareness. You know what your decisions cost per month.

LANGUAGES

German and English, both negotiating levels. The team is international; our suppliers and machine builders are largely German-speaking.

PRESENCE

Berlin, on site. This is a hardware company — the work happens at the machine. We do not run this role remotely.

  • You need consensus before you move.

  • You want certainty about the outcome. Nobody can give it to us, including you.

Every one of Multiverse's 800+ employees needs data to do their job well, and in the AI era - our ability to leverage data is more important than ever!

As Director of Data Products, you will own the platform, the products, the tools, the processes and the self-serve layer, so that the answer arrives before the request does.

You will be a force-multiplier for the quality, velocity and impact of Multiverse's decision making, and a driving force behind how data and AI are leveraged across the entire business. You will ensure that how we interact with data and deliver data products fully realises the potential of AI.

You will sit in the Data & Insight leadership team, reporting to our VP of Data & Insight, with a seat in company-wide planning and governance forums. You will manage 8 analytics engineers and developers within a wider team of ~20, collaborating with senior stakeholders across the org to coordinate a complex set of competing needs.

What you'll own

Data leverage across Multiverse

  • The platform, products and self-serve layer that ~800 people use to find, understand and act on our data — reducing the dependency on Data & Insight to answer questions others could answer themselves.

  • Direction on tooling: evaluate the options, make the call, take the organisation through the change.

  • Curation of our semantic layer so it covers Multiverse's core business concepts, data and metrics — with clear ownership and stewardship agreed with Domain D&I Leads and business stakeholders, and core architecture aligned with the Director of Data Engineering.

  • Governance embedded through the platform itself — quality, definitions, stewardship, access — so that trust and speed stop being a trade-off.

  • Real adoption, through documentation, training and support that reaches every relevant domain. Optimising the user experience alongside secure controls and seamless interconnectivity (APIs, MCPs).

Cross-functional roadmap delivery

  • D&I's operational planning process: around 50 quarterly projects properly scoped, clearly defined and appropriately resourced, with capacity reallocated as priorities move.

  • Representation of D&I in company-wide planning and governance forums, bringing a data lens to decisions being made elsewhere in the business.

  • A roadmap that reflects genuine business priority rather than the loudest request, with data needs surfaced early.

  • Progress against milestones — risks identified ahead of time, blockers raised, solutions coordinated.

Operational excellence

  • Driving the team's cycle planning, standups and retrospectives, run so they are genuinely useful and action-oriented.

  • Standards, playbooks and best practice for how work is scoped, how handoffs happen and how outputs are documented — with AI embedded where it creates real leverage.

  • Fair triage of inbound support and feature requests, and an escalation route for issues that cross domain boundaries.

  • D&I's own operational metrics — project velocity, support throughput, self-serve adoption — tracked and improved. Operational tooling (Asana, Claude) kept current and visible.

People leadership

  • Day-to-day leadership of our Analytics Engineers and Analytics Developers: weekly 1:1s, development conversations, meaningful goals.

  • Skill gaps identified and closed, through formal training, peer learning or stretch work.

  • Fostering a high-performance team culture built on accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Hiring and onboarding as the team grows.

What we're looking for

Few people will bring every one of these. If you are strong across most, we would like to hear from you.

  • 10+ years in data, analytics or technical operations, including 3+ years managing and developing technical teams such as analytics engineers or BI developers.

  • Evidenced use of AI to make a measurable difference to how an organisation uses its data, or how a data team operates — and the ability to lead others into those ways of working. This is a high bar for us: we are past curiosity.

  • A track record of making data genuinely self-serve in a complex or scaling organisation, with governance — quality, definitions, stewardship, access control — as part of how you did it.

  • Ownership of operational planning for a data team: capacity, prioritisation, agile-style ceremonies, delivery against a busy roadmap, and the project tooling (Asana, Jira or similar) that holds it together.

  • Credibility with senior stakeholders across functions — able to hold your own in a planning room, translate complex plans for technical and non-technical audiences, and build trust across the business.

  • A real interest in developing people, with the judgement to coach, challenge and support individuals at different stages of their careers.

  • Organised, detail-minded, and calm in ambiguity — pragmatic enough to make progress before the picture is complete.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

raw.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We are looking for a Data Product Manager to join our team in the UK. This role sits at the intersection of business, product, data and engineering, helping turn complex business needs into clear, actionable product direction.

Your Mission

As a Data Product Manager, you will own and evolve data-focused products, working closely with business stakeholders, Application Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Scientists.

A key part of your role will be navigating complex business environments, understanding different stakeholder needs and turning complex requirements into a clear and prioritized product roadmap that can be delivered over the coming months.

You will also bridge the gap between business and technology, going deeper into functional and non-functional requirements and helping translate them into clear technical requirements and user stories for engineering teams.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own, define and continuously evolve the product roadmap for data products and initiatives.

  • Understand complex business problems and translate them into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Deep dive into functional and non-functional requirements and help translate them into technical requirements for engineering teams.

  • Partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Application Engineers.

  • Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical dependencies and product objectives.

  • Work with engineering teams to ensure requirements are clear, feasible and aligned with the overall product strategy.

  • Use data and SQL to independently investigate and validate information when needed.

  • Manage different stakeholder expectations and create clarity in complex business environments.

  • Work within Agile/Scrum teams to support the continuous delivery and evolution of the product.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager working with data products, BI/analytics products, data platforms or data infrastructure.

  • Strong experience owning and managing a product roadmap.

  • Ability to navigate complex business environments and turn multiple or ambiguous requirements into clear priorities and deliverable plans.

  • Strong understanding of data ecosystems and application development.

  • Ability to translate business needs into functional, non-functional and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on SQL knowledge, with the ability to independently validate and explore data.

  • Experience working directly with Application Engineers, Data Engineers and/or Data Scientists.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ML/AI model deployment or MLOps.

  • Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI.

Working Model

This is a UK-based hybrid position, with an expectation of being in the office 2–3 days per week.

title: Account Director, Maritime
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong><br><br>Anduril Maritime delivers platforms, systems and integrated effects in the maritime domain. Autonomous vehicles are central to these capabilities, with sustained emphasis on endurance, autonomy and mission capability. In Australia, the team’s work centres on Dive-XL. The Australian program spans the platform, payloads, autonomy and the supporting enterprise required to field and sustain the capability, delivered with an Australian workforce and an Australian supply chain, in close partnership with the Commonwealth.<br><br><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong><br><br>As Account Director - Maritime you will support Anduril’s customer engagement for Dive-XL in Australia. You will be a key stakeholder in the Australian customer relationship and a principal voice of the customer within the product organisation, working across the Royal Australian Navy (RAN), Naval Shipbuilding and Sustainment Group (NSSG), Defence Science and Technology (DST) Group and the Commonwealth departments that shape, sponsor and fund the program. You will operate as part of a broader engagement team spanning Growth, Programs, Engineering and Contracts rather than as the sole interface to the customer. The role combines operational background, capability development experience and commercial judgement. You will be credible discussing autonomy behaviours and payload trade-offs with engineering teams, familiar with how capability requirements are developed, contested and funded within Defence, and conversant with the ASDEFCON framework through which intent becomes contracted scope. This is a senior, externally facing role in which your operational judgement and customer insight will directly inform how an autonomous undersea capability is defined, developed and deployed.</p> <p><strong>Internal Interfaces</strong><br>Product Director, XL-AUV: You report to the Product Director and provide prioritised customer and operational input to the Dive-XL roadmap, ensuring that Australian requirements are represented in product decisions and that customer commitments remain consistent with the capability plan.<br><br>SEA1200 Program Director: The Account Director and the SEA1200 Program Director operate as a partnership across the same program. The Program Director owns contract execution and the delivery organisation that performs it; you own the customer interface, keeping the contract sold and creating the conditions to extend it. Both roles work from a shared understanding of commitments, delivery performance and customer expectations, and neither succeeds without the other.<br><br>Growth and Global Defence: You work with the Growth organisation and Anduril’s Global Defence teams to identify, qualify and support capture opportunities, aligning Australian pursuits with wider international campaigns and ensuring that description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver.
